# Sebin P Johnson

> Engineering Manager, AI at Magnit Global. Self-taught engineer with 9+ years
> across full-stack, data infrastructure, and AI product engineering. Based in
> Kerala, India, working remotely.

This is a single-page portfolio. The page tells the story in nine chapters:
self-taught origins; Edstem Technologies (2017–2021, junior → lead, built a
WhatsApp Web automation interface before official APIs existed — never
shipped — and migrated a legacy Java monolith to Node.js microservices on
Kubernetes); PSCTalks (client app shipped as its initial solo developer, now
maintained by a full team, 500k+ downloads, 4.6★); WillHire (lead full-stack,
acquired by PRO Unlimited / Magnit in 2021); Magnit data infrastructure (near-zero-downtime
Oracle→Postgres migration via Kafka + Debezium, the "Data Ocean" OLAP
warehouse); and Maggi (Magnit's GenAI companion — LLM orchestration, RAG over
pgvector — built by his team of eleven).
